Flow.description: BOPI-532 Ensures that all required fields on related objects are correctly filled based on the products added to the opportunity. BOPI-532 Update 11/08/2024 to validate the new HC Merchant processing products required fields. BOPI-532 Updated 11/22/2024 to include Third party invoicing validation. BOPI-620 Updated to ensure the ARR fields are validated only for new quote lines. BOPI-631 Updated to request ARR information on XB/DOM only for one line for each ship to account (Requires_ARR_Fields_Completion__c = true). BOPI-628 Updated Merchant Processing BPS product code FWHC1300 -> FWHC1330 BOPI-727 Adjust required fields on HC products BOPI-798 The DOM ARR fields now need to be filled in always regardless of the Account shipping country BOPI-857 Allow opportunity products to have ARR $0 (Not blank) SALDEV-1279 Update ARR calculation field requirement.

formulas.description:
Average Tuition by Semester consists of four fields:
Annual In-State Avg. Tuition % In State
Annual Out-of-State Avg. Tuition % Out of State
At least one of these tuition and percentage pairs must be completed to calculate the average tuition per semester.
formulas.name: AvgTuitionBySemesterCalculation
formulas.expression: (IF(AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.In_State_Avg_Tuition__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.In_State__c}))), (({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.In_State_Avg_Tuition__c} * {!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.In_State__c}) / 2), 0 ) + IF(AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.Out_of_State_Avg_Tuition__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.Out_of_State__c}))), (({!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.Out_of_State_Avg_Tuition__c} * {!Find_products_with_ARR_required_fields.Ship_To_Account__r.Out_of_State__c}) / 2), 0 )) /100
